title: 739. My Calendar III

examples.explanation: Peak overlap climbs to 3 at the fourth booking and stays there.

hints: Record +1 at each start and -1 at each end in an ordered map of time deltas.
After each booking, sweep the deltas in time order with a running total; the maximum is the current peak.
Half-open slots mean an ending at t frees the point before a slot starting at t begins, which the ordered sweep handles naturally.
